items.title: Unit 8 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: The cub and the pup are friends. They live in a hut. I like to make buns. I like to run for fun! The cub hums and cuts nuts. I like buns, too! Yum!
items.why: In “Friends”, you hear: They live in a hut. The missing word is “hut”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 8, p.79 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
